Corollary
[Comparison of scalar curvature at space-time points] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0291, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0292 ↗ cor:chow-ii-trace-harnack-and-tr-monotonicity 1. ch15:15.5\group Trace Harnack Estimates

Under the hypotheses of Theorem 2, \[ \partial _t\log R- rac12| abla \log R|^2+ rac1t\ge 0, \] and, for $t_2>t_1>0$, \[ rac{R(x_2,t_2)}{R(x_1,t_1)}\ge rac{t_1}{t_2} \exp \! \left(- rac{d_{g(t_1)}(x_1,x_2)^2}{2(t_2-t_1)} ight). \]
Proof

\sketch Nonnegative curvature operator gives $0\le \Ric \le Rg$. Insert $V=- abla R/(2R)$ into the trace estimate. For a path $\gamma :[t_1,t_2] o \mathcal M$, the resulting inequality and $2\langle X,Y angle \le |X|^2+|Y|^2$ imply

\[ rac d{dt}\log (tR(\gamma (t),t))\ge - rac12|\dot\gamma (t)|_{g(t)}^2. \]

Since $\Ric \ge 0$, $g(t)\le g(t_1)$. Integrate along a constant-speed $g(t_1)$-minimizing geodesic and minimize its energy.

□
